facts.fact: 搭档Flint说两人在Void往返over twelve hours无食无眠
facts.anchor: into the Void for over twelve hours with no food or rest

facts.fact: Flint与Petra在Spine Woods岔路左转深入,没右转去Obscuris Theater
facts.anchor: instead of going right toward the Obscuris Theater like Jade and I had

facts.fact: Flint过桥跨Second Layer河后,带Petra走进左侧森林深处的alcove
facts.anchor: We walk over a small bridge that crosses the Second Layer river.

facts.fact: Flint烤了eight long, angular legs的flesh spider,配加热的一袋米饭
facts.anchor: Something the size of a cat with eight long, angular legs is skewered

facts.fact: Petra在洞口拉trip wire接回包上铃铛作警报
facts.anchor: I unspool a trip wire, running it across the ground by the alcove’s opening
Coltan distracted them while I crawled into a crevice.

facts.fact: Flint说哥哥死于他发出的mission,他要把它完成
facts.anchor: My brother died on a mission that I sent us on. And I’m going to finish it.

facts.fact: 孤儿院夜袭中Jade开训练武器柜发短剑小矛,最后给Petra一把木柄长刀
facts.anchor: she handed me a long knife with a wooden handle
